- TOTAL revenue TW was £124.9k versus LW £40.4k and LY £47.1k, with WoW change of 209.3% and YoY change of 165.1%.

- PICNIC BASKET WICKER 60 PIECES led product revenue TW at £39.6k.
- PARTY BUNTING recorded TW revenue of £4.0k, and DOORMAT KEEP CALM AND COME IN recorded TW revenue of £2.8k.
- DOORMAT BLACK FLOCK had the largest WoW revenue increase at 14,502.5%, followed by DOORMAT UNION JACK GUNS AND ROSES at 11,548.5% WoW.
- SET 3 WICKER OVAL BASKETS W LIDS rose 4,529.2% WoW, while SET/4 WHITE RETRO STORAGE CUBES fell 68.1% WoW and JUMBO BAG DOILEY PATTERNS fell 42.2% WoW.
- TEA TIME PARTY BUNTING showed the highest YoY revenue growth at 2,828.5%, ahead of PAPER BUNTING VINTAGE PAISLEY at 571.4% YoY.
- LUNCH BAG BLACK SKULL. declined 91.0% YoY, and LUNCH BAG WOODLAND declined 84.0% YoY.
